name: Directus
compose:
services:
  directus:
    image: directus/directus:11
    environment:
      SECRET: ${SECRET}
      ADMIN_EMAIL: ${ADMIN_EMAIL}
      ADMIN_PASSWORD: ${ADMIN_PASSWORD}
      DB_CLIENT: sqlite3
    ports:
      - '8056:8055'
    volumes:
      - directus-data:/directus/database
